raw_segments.text: Then, I said, the business of us who are the founders of the State will be to compel the best minds to attain that knowledge which we have already shown to be the greatest of all—they must continue to ascend until they arrive at the good—but when they have ascended and seen enough we must not allow them to do as they do now.

Then, I said, The business of us who are the founders of the State will be to compel the best minds to attain that knowledge which we have already shown to be the greatest of all. They must continue to ascend until they arrive at the good. But when they have ascended, and seen enough, we must not allow them to do as they do now.
